detail.longDescription: Some autoantibodies against neuronal targets found in people with # LongCovid but no specific signature....it's heterogeneous. Not surprised at all by this finding. ME/CFS and long covid have an autoimmune component but they are not classic autoimmune diseases like MS or myasthenia gravis, which have specific autoantibodies associated with them. They're illnesses of a more heterogeneous immune dysfunction. https:// insight.jci.org/articles/view/ 207122 # LongCovid # medicine # research
